Cozy dinner with authentic grilled noodles
Mar 2026 • Family
Bringing the family out to eat at the Zhongyuan branch is a very good decision, as the ambience here is polite and airy. The on-site grilled nem is always steaming hot, and the sweet meat is fragrant, and the sour taste of the handmade nem makes for an incredible food trick. The staff here is very emotional, especially the young ones who always support the older ones driving and open very polite doors, making everyone at home feel comfortable and satisfied.
